text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian newspapers this morning.

-The headquarters of motorbike gang, Bandidos, was destroyed by a bomb just before midnight. It is still not known who is responsible for the explosion, which happened in the city of Drammen just outside of Oslo, or how many people who were injured in the blast.
-Norwegian artists get little attention from the international art community. This year no Norwegian artists have been invited to present their work at the annual Documenta exhibition in Italy.
-Seven of the ten worst performing shares on the Oslo bourse are technology shares. However, some technology shares are also among the winners.

-Exploration drilling in northern parts of the North Sea has been disappointing. So far exploration drilling in deep waters at Nykhoegda has showed no traces of oil and too little natural gas to support further development.

-Savings bank group Sparebankgruppen may consider withdrawing its bid for Fokus Bank. If the group decides to give up the battle to takeover Fokus it could lose a considerable amount of money because of a drop in the bank's share price.
